drawings.name: line_tap_glass
drawings.prompt: A classic kitchen tap (faucet) seen from the side and slightly from the front: a curved spout coming out of a wall-mounted pipe, with one round cross-shaped handle on top. An invented person's hand (only the hand and wrist, coming in from the right) is turning the handle. A steady stream of water falls from the spout into an ordinary drinking glass standing below, the glass half full with a few small splash drops. Portrait image 1024x1536; the tap, hand, stream and glass fill about 80% of the width and about 85% of the height, centred. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

drawings.name: line_ruler_curve
drawings.prompt: An invented student character (simple round face, dot eyes, short messy hair, hoodie) kneeling on the floor beside a big sheet of paper on which a large smooth wavy curve (two hills and a valley) is drawn. The student holds a straight wooden ruler against the curve and is trying to trace it with a pencil, but the ruler only makes straight lines: a few short straight pencil segments miss the curve. Beside the student lies a neat pile of more straight rulers of different lengths. The student frowns, puzzled. Landscape image 1536x1024; the sheet, curve, student and rulers fill about 90% of the width. No text, no letters, no numbers on the rulers or the paper.

drawings.name: line_switch_dimmer
drawings.prompt: Two simple light fittings side by side, seen straight from the front, each a wall plate with a hanging light bulb above it on a short cord. Left: a plate with a plain up-down toggle switch, its bulb fully lit with a few short ray lines. Right: a plate with a round turning dimmer knob with a pointer notch, its bulb glowing softly with fewer, shorter ray lines. The two plates are the same size and sit at the same height, with clear space between the two fittings. Landscape image 1536x1024; the two fittings fill about 85% of the width and about 80% of the height. No text, no letters, no numbers, no tick marks.

drawings.name: line_wilted_plant
drawings.prompt: A small potted plant whose leaves and stem droop sadly, wilted, a couple of fallen leaves on the ground beside the pot. Next to the pot stands a watering can tipped forward as if pouring, but nothing comes out of its spout: it is empty and dry. Square image 1024x1024; the pot, plant and watering can fill about 80% of the width, centred, resting on a short ground line. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

drawings.name: line_tap_two_people
drawings.prompt: Two invented characters (simple round faces, dot eyes) working one water pipe together, seen from the front. On the left, the first character stands on a small step stool and pours water from a big jug into a funnel on top of a vertical pipe. The pipe runs down and turns right into a tap with a big round valve wheel. On the right, the second character, standing on the floor, holds the valve wheel with both hands and turns it, watching the water carefully. Below the tap's spout, water flows into a bucket on the floor. Landscape image 1536x1024; the two characters, pipe, tap and bucket fill about 90% of the width and about 80% of the height. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
